The VNC Cloud REST API manages cloud addresses that allow devices to join VNC Cloud and establish remote connections through RealVNC's managed broker service. Cloud addresses serve as stable identifiers for devices participating in VNC Cloud connectivity. Supports creating, listing, updating, resetting, and deleting cloud addresses with access control via groups and allowlisted peer addresses.
